purpose: Freeze the smallest family-safe robustness battery that can either retain exact fixed MapLight or prospectively select one materially superior drop-one simplification before any confirmatory truth opens.
hypothesis: The accepted fixed MapLight recipe is stable to model seed and conservative family regrouping, is not driven by duplicate or influential-family weighting, and no single feature-block deletion is a materially superior simpler contender.
occam_rule: Keep exact fixed MapLight unless one and only one prospectively eligible drop-one recipe is selected by the frozen ordering. Never add a feature, learner, seed ensemble, clip, calibration, or blend. A selected deletion removes complexity; observed diagnostics cannot create another candidate.
targeted_failure_modes: V1/V2 molecule, exact-duplicate, tautomer, or reconstructed-family leakage
V3 validation-truth access before complete prediction freeze
V4 seed, split, feature, parameter, runtime, or execution-order drift
V6 tutorial-metric or paired-bootstrap arithmetic drift
C4 tautomer or charge-state grouping sensitivity
C5 duplicate weighting drives the apparent result
C6 one MapLight feature block adds unjustified or harmful complexity
E1 performance is concentrated in one endpoint, source slice, or influential family
S4 family-threshold or clipping sensitivity hides unstable extrapolation
P1/P5/P6 environment, receipt, partial-publication, overwrite, retry, or private-portal contamination

g3_terminal_failure.meaning: EXP-G3 is closed without a model-quality result and cannot be retried or repaired.

direct_maplight_deployment.use: Exact full-training recipe reference only; this contract grants no test or submission access.

accepted_inputs.source_policy: A future trusted compiler may bind exact private roots only after separate official-shaped synthetic acceptance and a reviewed single-use claim. This contract lists or opens no private root.

runtime.fit_parallelism: one fit at a time with thread_count=16

population.primary_group_rule: The accepted D-032 similarity_component_hash at inclusive Morgan/Tanimoto threshold 0.60 remains the only candidate-selection and confirmatory group unit.
population.confirmatory_rule: Confirmatory membership remains the accepted label-free G2-0 assignment. No perturbation may move, parse, or score a confirmatory target.

fixed_maplight.fit_call: fit(X_outer_training, y_outer_training) with no additional arguments
fixed_maplight.prediction_rule: No calibration, clipping, blend, averaging across seeds, endpoint-specific parameter, or model serialization.

stage_a_selection.chronology: Complete and freeze all four drop-one and five full-feature seed-perturbation outer predictions before any outer validation truth, fixed MapLight OOF row, tutorial metric, or component metric opens.

candidate_selection.drop_one_eligibility: Against exact full MapLight on identical primary D-032 rows, require at least 1% lower tutorial-primary MA-ST-RAE or at least 0.005 lower component-macro MAE; require the paired component-bootstrap upper 95% bound of candidate minus full below zero; require at least 8/15 favorable outer cells; and permit no endpoint component-MAE degradation above 0.005.
candidate_selection.ordering: Among eligible deletions choose fewer feature columns, then lower tutorial-primary value, then lower component-macro MAE, then lexicographically smaller candidate_id. If none is eligible, retain G2-7-M0-FULL.

stage_b_selected_robustness.chronology: After the immutable selection token, a separate model capability may fit only that selected recipe under the three frozen grouping perturbations. Freeze every perturbation prediction before the final scorer opens its validation truth.

group_perturbations.rule: Rebuild a label-free Morgan-radius-2/4096/chiral inclusive Tanimoto graph at threshold 0.55 over all accepted molecule identities. Exclude every development molecule in a perturbed component touching any confirmatory identity, then hash-assign intact remaining components to five folds for each accepted repeat seed without target access.
Apply the identical conservative overlay at inclusive threshold 0.50. This is a stricter merged-family diagnostic and can never replace the primary D-032 groups.

Using the pinned parent RDKit standardization, merge original D-032 components when their accepted structures share an RDKit canonical-tautomer isomeric-SMILES hash. Preserve raw chemistry and model features; the overlay changes grouping only. Exclude any overlay component touching confirmatory membership before deterministic fold assignment.

stage_b_selected_robustness.support_preflight: Before any perturbation fit, every endpoint/repeat/fold must retain at least 75 validation targets and 400 training targets. A miss publishes underpowered aggregate evidence and cannot move a component or open confirmatory truth.
stage_b_selected_robustness.family_invariant: No molecule, exact duplicate, original D-032 component, threshold-overlay component, or tautomer-overlay component may cross its active training/validation boundary.

stage_c_conditional_selected_seed_check.condition: Run only when the selected candidate is not G2-7-M0-FULL.
stage_c_conditional_selected_seed_check.rule: Fit the selected drop-one recipe under all five frozen seed-perturbation values on the unchanged primary D-032 folds. Seeds remain diagnostics and cannot replace, average, or alter the selected random_seed=1 recipe.

diagnostics_without_additional_fits.duplicate_policy: On primary frozen rows, recompute component metrics after first averaging absolute error within endpoint/repeat/fold/standardized_structure_hash so duplicate molecule identities cannot add weight. Report the paired change for full and selected recipes.
diagnostics_without_additional_fits.influential_families: Rank original D-032 development components by the selected recipe's total component-equal absolute-error contribution under exact full-data predictions, with component hash as tie-break. Recompute every primary and endpoint metric after removing exactly the top ten fixed components. The ranking cannot be rediscovered per candidate, seed, clip, or metric.
diagnostics_without_additional_fits.assay_source: The accepted direct source schema has one source_file field and the bound training artifact is expected to contain exactly the single value cyp-challenge-TRAIN_inhibition.csv. Publish SINGLE_SOURCE_NOT_APPLICABLE with zero source ablations. Any second value or unavailable provenance fails preflight; do not invent assay labels from row order or performance.

clipping.rule: Use exact finite float64 predictions unchanged. This remains the only deployable recipe.
Within each endpoint/repeat/fold, clip validation predictions only to the finite central-target minimum and maximum computed from that outer training partition.
Within each endpoint/repeat/fold, linearly interpolate training-only finite central-target quantiles at 0.005 and 0.995 using h=(n-1)*p, then clip validation predictions to those bounds.

diagnostics_without_additional_fits.clipping_boundary: Clipped diagnostics cannot select or modify the contender. If either diagnostic improves tutorial-primary MA-ST-RAE by more than 1% or component-macro MAE by more than 0.005, reject the unclipped contender as calibration-sensitive rather than adopting the clip.

primary.eligibility: Finite central point and both finite reported bounds; no imputation or midpoint.
primary.name_boundary: Local tutorial proxy only; never call it the live official score.

metrics.component_macro_mae: Equal weight per active component within endpoint, then equal macro weight across the four endpoints.
metrics.endpoint_harm: Report every endpoint separately for primary, seed, grouping, duplicate, influence, clipping, and ablation views.

paired_bootstrap.unit: sorted original D-032 component union with all eligible endpoint rows retained per draw
paired_bootstrap.interval: linearly interpolated 0.025 and 0.975 quantiles of candidate-minus-full component-macro MAE

robustness_acceptance.seed: For every required selected-recipe seed perturbation, tutorial-primary relative degradation is at most 0.03, component-macro MAE degradation is at most 0.015, and no endpoint component-MAE degradation exceeds 0.025 versus random_seed=1 on identical rows.
robustness_acceptance.grouping: Every perturbation passes support and containment; selected-recipe component-macro MAE is at most 0.030 above its unchanged-primary value and no endpoint is more than 0.050 worse. These are diagnostics and never replace primary groups.
robustness_acceptance.duplicate: Absolute selected-recipe component-macro MAE change after duplicate collapse is at most 0.010.
robustness_acceptance.influence: Absolute selected-recipe component-macro MAE change after the fixed top-ten removal is at most 0.020 and the selected recipe does not become worse than full MapLight by more than 0.005.
robustness_acceptance.source: The single accepted source is authenticated and the status is SINGLE_SOURCE_NOT_APPLICABLE; any invented or second source fails.
robustness_acceptance.endpoint: Every stage-specific endpoint-harm ceiling passes conjunctively.
robustness_acceptance.clipping: Neither training-only clip exceeds the frozen improvement trigger; the deployable recipe remains unclipped.
robustness_acceptance.constituent: Selection follows the exact drop-one eligibility and ordering once. No second deletion, refit choice, or post-robustness runner-up is permitted.

terminal_contract.publication: Publish exactly one aggregate-only read-only terminal through atomic no-replace promotion after row-level predictions, truths, features, and model state are cleaned.
terminal_contract.accepted_content: Bind the one selected candidate ID and exact recipe, all aggregate gate values, selected/full paired evidence, counts, receipts, resources, cleanup, and zero forbidden accounting. Do not publish row-level values or private portal observations.

resource_ceiling.margin: Each ceiling preserves at least 20% margin below a 200 CPU-core-hour, 12 wall-hour, 80 GB, 24 GiB robustness envelope.

confirmatory_boundary.meaning: This contract does not resolve or authorize G2-8. A later contract may create one score only after an accepted G2-7 terminal binds a distinct selected contender and exact confirmatory acceptance arithmetic. If full MapLight remains selected, that later contract must explicitly resolve the identical-contender/control boundary before any truth opens.

next_gate: After reviewed signed integration and green post-main CI, freeze a separate two-root synthetic implementation/resource contract for this exact staged topology. Do not create a claim, open an official byte, fit an official model, or access confirmatory truth in that milestone.
